environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in private subnet with direct VPC endpoint access to internal GraphQL service (Apollo Server). SQS queue accepts messages from multiple upstream producers including a partner integration API with no input sanitization. The GraphQL service uses a permissive schema with introspection enabled and no query depth/complexity limits. IAM role allows sqs:ReceiveMessage, sqs:DeleteMessage on the order queue. No request-level validation or parameterized query enforcement on the GraphQL server side.

config.network: Private subnet, VPC endpoint to GraphQL service on port 4000
config.graphql_server: Apollo Server 3.x, introspection enabled, no persisted queries, no query complexity analysis
config.sqs_access: Partner integration publishes directly via cross-account IAM role
config.input_validation: None - raw JSON from SQS consumed directly
